import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Candidate {
        long num;
        long den;
        double error;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        Candidate best = new Candidate();
        best.num = 0;
        best.den = 1;
        best.error = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long rem = (i * x) % y;
            long dist = Math.min(rem, y - rem);
            double cur = (double) dist / i;

            if (best.error > cur) {
                best.error = cur;
                best.den = i;
                long q = (i * x) / y;
                best.num = (dist == rem) ? q : q + 1;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(best.num + "/" + best.den);
        sc.close();
    }
}
